message: stopped after V_shown diagnostics; V_dropped more were suppressed
why: A single bad input can produce thousands of follow-on errors, and the useful ones are always at the top. The cap keeps the report readable and bounds memory on hostile IR.
fix: fix the first V_shown and re-run — the rest are usually consequences
or raise the cap with --max-diags if you really want the full list
